result.narrative:
Vodafone Idea sits at 25.4 and is flagged Watch, but the underlying picture is mixed rather than deteriorating across the board. There is one open overdue item under policy TCI-SCF-2026-0001, 18 days past due, against a INR 120M limit with total exposure around INR 40M, so utilisation remains moderate. News flow over the last quarter is dominated by neutral and positive items: a Reuters report that the company narrowed its quarterly loss on bigger per-user revenue, an SBI-led group providing $3.5 billion of debt, analyst notes from Citi, Nomura and Jefferies, and several stock rallies. Modelled PD is 0.1544 against a 0.25 target.

The band rests on two inputs: 0.65 x 18.0 for payment (weighted 11.7) plus 0.35 x 39.2 for news (weighted 13.7). The adjudicator agreed with the Watch outcome but with caveats, and flagged that the news side is probably overstated while the payment side is understated, with the two errors roughly offsetting. The single severity-2 article (GN-1caacc272320, decayed 39.25) supplies the entire news score; every other item is severity 0 or 1, the highest of which decays to 19.85, so correcting that one severity assignment would drop the total below the 20.0 cutoff into Healthy. That article's retrievable body is only its headline, and Reuters scored severity 0 on the same Q2 results one day earlier. Conversely, the formula reads only the 18 DPD snapshot and ignores the payment review's deteriorating trend.

Recommended action is MAINTAIN the INR 120M limit on LIM-IN03-1 (Meridia Bank, supply chain finance), unchanged, on the basis that PD of 0.1544 is within the 0.25 appetite and expected loss is unchanged at INR 13,340,160. Given the adjudicator's caveats, the underwriter should treat 25.4 as unstable in both directions: re-adjudicate the Q2 severity call, and monitor DPD on the open item rather than relying on the score. The amount owed is also unreconciled — the notification records INR 40,000,000 on one open item while the payment review describes the open overdue invoice as INR 9.0M with ~40M as total exposure.

The score is 5.4 points above the Healthy line at 20.0. Clearing the open overdue would remove the payment contribution, and re-scoring the contested Q2 article in line with the Reuters account of the same results would on its own take the total below 20.0. High Risk is a long way off at 50.0, 24.6 points away, and would need DPD to reach 43 on current news; with a 365-day news half-life, decay alone will not move the band quickly.

judgement.bottom_line: Maintain the INR 120M limit on LIM-IN03-1 — PD of 0.1544 is within the 0.25 appetite and expected loss is unchanged at INR 13,340,160. The adjudicator agreed with caveats: the Watch band hangs entirely on one severity-2 headline that is contradicted by Reuters on the same results, while the genuine concern — a lengthening payment trend — carries no weight in the score.

lifts_it: Clearing the open 18 DPD item under TCI-SCF-2026-0001
Re-adjudicating GN-1caacc272320 in line with the Reuters account of the same Q2 results
Score falling 5.4 points to below the 20.0 Healthy line
worsens_it: DPD on the open item rising toward 43, the level that reaches High Risk at 50.0
Further lengthening of resolution times beyond the current 5 to 9 to 18 day pattern
